finish_summary: Bulk discount for quantity ≥ 50 returns 5% instead of 10%; parse_coupon fails on case‑insensitive codes and ignores whitespace, raising ValueError; remove_item leaves an entry with quantity 0 instead of deleting it; subtotal rounds each discounted line item separately, giving 21.1 instead of the required 21.09 (round after summation); Cart.total does not raise ValueError for invalid coupons.
